scope: Additive relationship map from one N1 explanation to two existing planned feature topics. This is not a replacement matrix or an activation of personal inference.

relationships.new_user_benefit: Explains why the ordinary regression covariance assumption matters, distinguishes HC under independent heteroskedastic errors from HAC with serial dependence, and preserves the relevant model and dependence conditions.
remaining_inference_requirements: Evidence that the selected estimator, observation unit and dependence structure fit the actual measurement task.
Same-task test-retest error data and any required personal calibration; N1 does not supply ICC or SEM for training records.
Actual finite-sample interval performance and a separately justified useful-change threshold.

relationships.new_user_benefit: Explains why selecting HC/HAC or a software default alone cannot certify a short training-series interval or turn a descriptive trend into a plateau conclusion.
remaining_inference_requirements: A prespecified comparable observation task and appropriate uncertainty model.
Substantively justified practical-equivalence bounds and a valid repeated-look protocol where needed.
Task-specific calibration and validation; N1 neither labels a personal plateau nor establishes why performance changed.

limits: The N1 contract is a bounded source explanation reviewed by its implementer; it is not independent scientific acceptance.
The matrix references planned personal-method capabilities. Related explanatory material does not fill all of their activation requirements.
N1 remains a research-method source, distinct from the core training guidelines and from actual personal measurement data.
